title: DealsOfferCreatedPayload
description: deals.offer.created v1 (OpenVibe.Deals server/domain/indexing.js emitOffer, called from server/domain/offers.js submit and createImported). A deal was posted: a person submitted a link (submit), or the Sources importer created an offer from a deals-category Sources item (createImported, the only caller that adds imported_from). Written in the transaction that inserted the offer and its first observation, next to deals.index_document.upserted. The payload describes the canonical offer as it now stands: canonical page URL, status, store domain, product, the latest observation (price text exactly as stated, never inferred; null where the source or person stated nothing) with its observed_at, the freshness verdict and the Search-shaped indexability decision. Deliberately left out: the description, the submitter's identity, vote counts and hotness. Envelope: subject { type: offer, id: <offer_id> }, visibility public when the offer is active and the SEO gate lets it be listed, otherwise internal, priority important (default), actor user:<submitter usr_…> for a submission, service:deals for an import. No consumer is built yet.

slug.description: Page slug: the slugified title plus the last six characters of the id.

url.description: Canonical offer page URL on Deals (/d/<slug>).

status.description: A new offer is always active.

store.description: Store domain: the offer link's host without a leading www.; null when none could be derived.

product_id.description: Deals product the offer is attached to, if any.

latest_observation.description: The newest observation across the offer's merge group; null only when the group has none.

price.description: Decimal text as stated; null when no price was stated (never 0).

freshness.description: fresh while the latest observation is younger than DEALS_FRESHNESS_HOURS, stale after, unobserved without one.

indexability.description: The SEO gate decision in Search's shape (index-hooks searchIndexability).

reasons.description: Search reason names, e.g. stale_price, expired, takedown, owner_decision (imported or AI text awaiting review).

imported_from.description: Only on imports: the OpenVibe.Sources item the offer was created from.
